title: Capture of New Orleans
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of New Orleans", at revision 1381066398, opens: "The capture of New Orleans during the American Civil War was a turning point in the war that precipitated the capture of the Mississippi River. Having fought past Forts Jackson and St. Philip, the Union was unopposed in its capture of the city itself." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2700708, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1862 event of the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
